w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Redactor.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: Back at the haven the argument starts: Dante is calling it "Old Gavel." Nobody agrees yet — weigh in if you want.

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ THE FOCUS GROUP! You're on your own.

w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: The Spool stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Chorus Line is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 3 raiders (Big Big, Ugly-Eyes, The Terms of Service) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Callback.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ AD BREAK! You're on your own.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: "The future is a rerun. You've just seen the episode."
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "◈ The Records: You won The Informant under the cameras. The village's glory, public and loud."
✨ Ability gained: Foresight (L1). Reveal every monster’s intended move for three rounds. Uses no combat action; once per fight.
"The future is a rerun. You've just seen the episode."
"The REAL power? That comes from UNDERSTANDING. Use it! Learn it! The gamblers are watching!"
Nothing edible. (White Oak Acorns (in shell), Hickory Nuts (in shell) — not food yet: Needs shelling — crack and pick the nutmeats. (Shell action).)

w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
firstContext: 🤒 Dmitri is back on their feet — the fever ran its course.
📺 SYSTEM: "📡 The fifth draft stays in the wings — blood your fighters (0 of 2 veterans)."
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
— DAY 111 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, Hickory Nuts (in shell) went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: That night, they bring Miriam home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.
Greta came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
Village meal: +2500 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (18/9/5), with 2 wave-4 fought, 8 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept; the relay carried faithfully. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ OUTSHONE — Greta Hansen did what you would not: acted, boldly, while there was still time. The village thrives. The god is someone else. The record notes, kindly and accurately, that you watched. It stings exactly as much as it should.
